record_text: Procurement award record. Tender T-0417 for document printing services received four compliant bids by the 14 April deadline. The evaluation panel scored the bids against the published criteria on 18 April; Northline Print scored 82 of 100, the highest total, in score sheet SS-4417. The contract was awarded to Northline Print on 22 April. The award is based on score sheet SS-4417 and the bid register for 14 April.

Records request determination. Request RQ-0912 was granted in part on 3 June: seven of nine contracts located in the 2 June register search were released, and contracts FM-22 and FM-31 were withheld under the confidentiality markings on their cover pages. The determination adds that no other records relevant to the request exist anywhere in the organization.

Change approval record. The Change Advisory Board approved change request CR-2291, the reporting database upgrade, on 6 March because test report TR-118 shows the rollback rehearsal of 4 March passing within the 20-minute target, and because the 5 March capacity review measured 38% headroom on the upgraded cluster. Minutes item 3 lists both documents as reviewed.

Change approval record. Change request CR-2291 asked to upgrade the reporting database cluster to version 14. The rollback rehearsal on 4 March was recorded as passed in test report TR-118, and the capacity review dated 5 March found 38% headroom after the upgrade. The Change Advisory Board approved CR-2291 at its meeting of 6 March (minutes item 3). The approval relies on test report TR-118 and the 5 March capacity review.

Retention exception record. An exception to keep the Riverside design files for 3 years beyond the schedule was approved on 16 January under clause 9.1 of the Records Retention Standard. Clause 9.1 deals with extended retention. The exception is entered in the retention log.

Control assessment, logical access. Our review found the access-control environment operating effectively, with access appropriately restricted across critical systems. Quarterly access reviews are performed and provide reasonable assurance that terminated users are removed in a timely manner and that privileged access is limited to authorized personnel. No material weaknesses were identified. The control is rated Effective.

Procurement award record. Northline Print was awarded tender T-0417 on 22 April because its bid scored 82 of 100 on the published criteria, eleven points above the next bid, as shown in panel score sheet SS-4417 dated 18 April. The bid register lists four compliant bids received by the 14 April deadline.

Records request determination. Section 6 of the Information Access Policy permits withholding a document whose cover page marks it commercially confidential. For request RQ-0912, contracts FM-22 and FM-31 carry that marking on their cover pages, and they were withheld on 3 June under section 6. The other seven contracts located on 2 June carry no marking and were released.

Records request determination. Request RQ-0912 was received on 28 May, and the contract register search on 2 June located 9 contracts. Seven were released on 3 June, and contracts FM-22 and FM-31 were withheld under their confidentiality markings. The release letter of 3 June refers to the register search completed on 5 June.

Records request determination. Request RQ-0912 asked for the 2025 facilities maintenance contracts. The records team located 9 contracts and released 7 on 3 June. Two contracts were withheld because each contains a supplier's unit pricing marked commercially confidential on its cover page (contracts FM-22 and FM-31). The determination rests on the contract register search of 2 June and the two cover pages cited.

Records request determination. Two requests from the same requester were decided on 3 June. Request RQ-0912, for the 2025 maintenance contracts, was granted in part: seven contracts were released and FM-22 and FM-31 were withheld under their confidentiality markings. Request RQ-0915, for the 2024 cleaning rota, was refused because the register search of 2 June found no such document. Each request has its own reference.
